purpose: Freeze exact WCVP v13 name-resolution and native host-resource footprint rules before inspecting host-distribution coverage on the response-blind follow-up species universe.

host_name_resolution.input: exact Hostplant Genus + single-space + Hostplant Species from frozen HOSTS resource
host_name_resolution.match: exact WCVP taxon_name at species rank
host_name_resolution.accepted_mapping: map matched WCVP name to accepted_plant_name_id; accepted names map to their own plant_name_id
host_name_resolution.ambiguity_policy: if one input binomial maps to multiple distinct accepted_plant_name_id values, mark ambiguous and exclude from the primary footprint
host_name_resolution.unmatched_policy: exclude from primary footprint and count explicitly; no fuzzy matching after coverage is inspected

primary_native_distribution.duplicate_rows: collapse to distinct accepted host plant species x WGSRPD3 unit

per_insect_footprint.definition: union of primary native WGSRPD3 units across all resolved distinct species-level larval hosts for that insect
per_insect_footprint.duplicate_HOSTS_records: do not increase host or geographic weight
per_insect_footprint.pair_similarity: Jaccard similarity between source and target footprint unit sets

admissibility_outputs: number and fraction of HOSTS host binomials resolved unambiguously to WCVP accepted species
number and fraction of resolved host species with at least one primary native WGSRPD3 unit
per-insect counts of HOSTS species-level hosts, WCVP-resolved hosts, hosts with native distributions, and native WGSRPD3 units
response-blind species counts retaining host-resource footprints after the frozen geometry eligibility rule
train/eval and geographically-supported target counts under the inherited response-blind split

gate.if_fail: STOP before character masks or new nucleotide identity; any redesigned host taxonomy/distribution rule requires a new protocol version.
